 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. São Paulo and Corinthians have confirmed their lineups for this Wednesday's (4th) Majestoso derby in the Brasileirão.
 The derby is part of the championship's 33rd round and takes place at Vila Belmiro.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement São Paulo are hosting the match at Santos' traditional home because they are unable to use Morumbis, which has hosted concerts in recent days.
 Corinthians head into the match under greater pressure, needing a win to climb out of the relegation zone.
 São Paulo
 Forward Artur has regained his fitness and is available again. São Paulo therefore make four changes from their previous match.
 R. Toloi, Djhordney, Iago and Artur come into the side in place of Sabino, Wendell, Pablo Maia and Calleri.
 The Argentine striker starts on the bench due to muscle discomfort.
 Corinthians
 Matheuzinho is suspended and will miss Corinthians' derby this Wednesday.
 Pedro Milans replaces him.
